title: Add RESET handler to fd.c
description: In src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c: add ioctl_reset(state) handler. Checks fd_type==OPERATION. Checks finalized==true (return -EINVAL if not — reset before finalize is pointless). Calls state->ops->sess_reset(state->ctx); returns -EOPNOTSUPP if ops->sess_reset is NULL. On success: clears finalized=false, outbuf_len=0, outbuf_drained=0, bytes_written=0, bytes_read=0. Does NOT free outbuf (keep allocation for reuse). Add CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_RESET to dispatch switch at slot 19.
